description: Test vectors for the custom library id rule (W1b contracts 3.5.4, review finding G9). 'slugs' holds names and the slug LibraryNaming.Slug gives, which is exactly what DictionaryLibraryService.Slugify has always given; they were computed with that rule on .NET 10.0.12. 'newCustomIds' and 'remapIds' pin the suffix rule of LibraryNaming.NewCustomId and LibraryNaming.RemapId: the candidate, then -2, -3 and so on while it is taken, compared without case. The deciders stream owns this file; the storage stream's interim copy of the rule runs the same vectors.
